title: Cracks are emerging in the AI spending boom | TechCrunch
summary: Microsoft was the only exception when it came to free cash flow — it recorded $18.6 billion in positive free cash flow in its latest quarter, with spending on capex at $45.2 billion, less than the $50 billion it projected.
